articleTitle: A SCAPS Simulation Study to Optimize Formamidinium Lead Iodide Solar Cells for Sustainable Energy Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: In this research article discusses the require for sustainable and renewable source, and the potential of perovskite solar cell, specifically Formamidinium Lead Iodide (FASnI3), in meeting this demand. Although FASnI3 has shown high photovoltaic performance (PV), low cost of production, and tunable optoelectronic properties, optimizing its efficiency, stability, and long-term performance remains a challenge. The study presents a simulation using the SCAPS simulator to optimize the thickness of FASnI3 solar cells and analyze the impact of bulk defect density (Nt) on their performance. The simulation results demonstrated potential methods for increasing the efficiency of FASnI3 solar cells and offer insightful information about the variables that have an impact on their performance. The design of the simulated perovskite cell and its operation, which includes various layers such as Cu/PEDOT: PSS + WO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/FASnI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> (active layer)/PC61BM/FTO are also discussed. In order to evaluate the efficiency of the device, the effect of thickness change and Nt of F ASnI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>- based PSC has been addressed. In the proposed study, the FASnI3 absorber layers Nt varied from 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> – 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>, as well as their thickness modified from 50 – 500 nm. After the disparity, the cell performs best on low defect density and higher thickness, which offered better PV characteristics i.e., -J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SC</inf>: 27.6 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, Voc: 1.31 V, FF: 88%, and the PCE: 30.3%.

articleTitle: Forecasting Crop Price using various approaches of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Agriculture is the Backbone of India. India has major portion of cultivational Land. Many Crops have lot of demand in abroad. India is one of the major exporters of Food products other than software. But due to erratic climatic conditions, lack of human Resource and improper decision making in choosing crops, farmers are not able to make profits. Also due to urbanization, Agriculture Profession is losing its importance slowly. This problem has invited many Researchers to identify the issues and apply several Machine Learning approaches like Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA), Decision trees, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), K Nearest Neighbor (KNN) etc. for accurate Yield and Crop Price Prediction. This helps the Farmers to select suitable crops and obtain maximum yield and Profit.

articleTitle: Pneumonia Detection and Classification with CNN-GAN Augmentation Using Fine Tuning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Pneumonia is a respiratory condition that leads to the enlargement of the lungs due to the accumulation of fluid in the air sacs and alveoli. If left untreated, it can cause damage to one or both lungs. According to a study conducted by the World Health Organization, individuals with weakened immune systems, such as children, babies, and those aged 65 and above, are at a higher risk of contracting this disease. The study considered three types of pneumonia: normal, viral, and bacterial. To diagnose the condition, chest X-rays were used, as they are widely available and cost-effective. The patients' X-ray images were carefully examined during the investigation. We collected pictures from online archives and used GAN (Generative Adversarial Network) to augment the dataset, which improved the effectiveness of our CNN model's training. Next, we conducted tuning optimization to automate the processes in the CNN model. Once the optimization was completed, we tested the model using the dataset and classified the disease using a combination of CNN and GAN with a joint fine-tuning approach and as a result the model achieved an accuracy of 99%. With the help of the proposed approach, pneumonia identification can be accelerated, and even with a limited dataset, the categorization of the illness can be done optimally. This method could potentially be a life-saving tool and offer valuable second opinions for radiologists and other medical professionals, aiding them in the efficient treatment of patients.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Based Approach to Predicting Flight Fares for Indian Airlines
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Flight ticket prices fluctuate drastically depending upon a number of factors such as fuel prices, government regulations, routes taken, festival seasons, airline policies, etc. Flight aggregator websites fail to educate the consumers on an optimally effective timing for purchasing tickets without any data analyses backing them up. The proposed work helps to predict the flight ticket based on various factors using Machine Learning (ML) approaches. The proposed work analyses the Indian Domestic Airlines data on various machine learning models for computing expected future prices of Indian Airlines. The proposed model can be used by airlines to reduce human error in ticket pricing, manage price offerings to meet revenue targets, and increase profits. Experimental results helps to identify the best ML approach and results in higher statistical evaluation scores.

articleTitle: Agroassist: Agriculture Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: The global population is steadily increasing. The growing population is not the only challenge that modern farmers face. Agriculture has long been important to human existence. Without a doubt, we can state that it is the main source of both animal and plant goods. Additionally, it contributes significantly to a country's economic development by offering folks have several opportunities. Agriculture is an ideal application for robotics innovation: Repetitive tasks in the field, performed by farmers are primarily labor-intensive. More sophisticated IoT sensors can monitor moisture levels autonomously and send real-time analytics to a smart device with help of machine learning model. Because of the average field size, it is nearly impossible to properly monitor the state of a harvest. Previously, satellite imagery was the most reliable solution, but it did not provide farmers with enough assurances: such images were inaccurate and did not provide real-time information. The scope of automated agriculture has expanded far beyond its initial application of smart technology to optimise machinery. Rather, it is now attempting to transform machinery into smart technology. A growing number of companies are working on robotics innovation to create drones, self-driving tractors, robotic harvesters, automatic watering systems, and seeding robots. Although these technologies are relatively new, an increasing number of traditional agriculture companies are incorporating farm automation into their operations.

articleTitle: Sewage Monitoring System for Blockage Point Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: The wastewater that our society discharges from the sewages includes the discharges from various companies, factories, residences, institutes, organizations etc. A proper management of these sewages is an unavoidable need to have a healthy community. Thus, our sewage management becomes an essential responsibility of the municipal infrastructure. In order to have healthy and systematic sewage management, we need to maintain the drainage system properly. Otherwise, it ends up in urban floods, which is most common in crowded cities. In a metropolitan city the importance of having a well-maintained drainage system is very essential. Proper maintenance in such crowded cities will result in pandemic situations. At present, there is no technology available to check and monitor the water level in sewage. Different types of works are being done to provide a proper management of the underground system by which it could find out the defects and correct them properly. As a step to rectify this problem, a hardware model is designed to monitor the sewage system, which uses devices based on IOT and sensors. The paper proposes a smart device that can detect the exact location of the blockage in the drainage system using an ultrasonic sensor and the overflow of water. It also has an alert system specifying the exact location of the block using GPS sensor and cloud to report it to the municipal authority for further action.

articleTitle: Survey On Next Word Prediction Techniques In Natural Languages
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Next word prediction is the core problem of NLP, which has numerous applications, to predict which word will be said next. Researchers used several word-level statistical and deep learning models to generate the text. In the past, before the advancement of deep learning techniques, statistical techniques were used to predict the next word. These methods have the drawback of generating text without ensuring the syntactic accuracy of the sentences. Neural networks have also become more popular than traditional methods due to their accuracy in word prediction. Nowadays, word prediction is often done using LSTM, Bi-LSTM, and GRU. This paper provides a survey of different techniques with their classification for predicting the next word and evaluates them. Also, this work identified research gaps and provide some future directions based on the findings.

articleTitle: Enhanced YOLOv7 Model for Accurate Vehicle Detection from UAV Imagery
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: The advancements in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) technology have revolutionized aerial surveillance and monitoring applications, with vehicle detection being a crucial aspect in fields like traffic management, urban planning, and security. However, traditional vehicle detection methods face challenges in handling complex scenarios, real-time processing, and scalability. To overcome these challenges, this research paper proposes an advanced AI-driven vehicle detection system utilizing the YOLOv7 model. The YOLOv7 model, a cutting-edge object detection algorithm, excels in real-time processing and precise object localization in images and video frames. This study harnesses the capabilities of YOLOv7 for vehicle detection from UAV imagery. By integrating the YOLOv7 model with UAV data, the proposed system achieves robust and efficient vehicle detection in diverse environmental conditions. Extensive experimental evaluations are conducted on a real-world UAV imagery dataset to assess the performance of the proposed system. The evaluations involve comparing the proposed AI-driven vehicle detection system with existing methods in terms of accuracy, processing speed, and scalability. The results demonstrate the superior performance of the YOLOv7 based system, achieving high detection rates with minimal computational overhead. The findings of this research significantly contribute to the field of vehicle detection from UAV imagery by introducing an advanced AI driven approach utilizing the YOLOv7 model. The proposed system has the potential to enhance various applications, including traffic monitoring, accident prevention, and urban planning. Furthermore, this study provides valuable insights into the integration of deep learning algorithms with UAV technology, paving the way for future advancements in aerial surveillance and monitoring systems.

articleTitle: Modified Hybrid DC-DC Converter for EV Charging Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Electric vehicles have gained popularity in the recent years due to the several benefits including reduced atmospheric pollution and non-dependency on fossil fuels. However certain factors such as the shortage of proper charging infrastructure, range of the vehicle etc. has put some restrictions on flourishing electric vehicle industry. The dependency on fossil fuels and hence atmospheric pollution is not overcome if electric vehicles are drawing power from the existing conventional grid. It is therefore highly desired, the development of renewable energy based charging stations. However the intermittency and unstable nature of renewable energy sources is still an issue. A hybrid forward boost dc-dc converter is designed which is capable of providing a regulated dc output voltage of 155V even under varying input conditions of 30V to 55V. The scheme of constant current - constant voltage (CC-CV) charging is implemented in the hybrid converter for charging the electric vehicle (EV) battery. The simulation results reveal the feasibility of the designed control architecture.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Auto Accident Detection and Alert System for Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: The increasing number of vehicles, especially in urban areas, has led to a rise in traffic violations and accidents. In India, accidents are a leading cause of death, with over 75% of fatalities resulting from the inability to provide prompt assistance. To address this issue, the objective is to develop a system that can identify accidents using CCTV footage and send alerts to the nearest control room. The system utilizes deep learning algorithms such as VGG16 for image classify video frames as accidents or no accidents, these neural networks have shown to be quick and precise at image classification, showing a 95% higher accuracy rate than other algorithms, while also requiring less pre-processing.

articleTitle: Real Estate Management System using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Real Estate is the third largest asset class in the world only behind the stock market and the bond market. The entire real estate market is valued at over $7 trillion and is expected to cross $8 trillion by 2028. With an ever growing population and the land being limited in the world it would be safe to assume that this asset class keeps on growing according to the simple rules of law of Supply and Demand. So we have to come up with new methods to improve the process of purchasing real estate as well as eliminate the third parties in between. So in order to make these processes more efficient we can use the technology of blockchain in the process. We can improve the various issues involving transparency and also promote partial ownership of properties.

articleTitle: SCAPS-1D Simulation Analysis of Antimony Selenide -based Solar Cells with Thickness-Dependent Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: The antimony selenide (Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) based solar cell, composed of non-toxic and cost-effective materials, is seen as a promising contender in the photovoltaic (PV) industry due to its low cost and abundant availability. However, the device performance is still limited. Therefore, in the present study, PV device incorporating a Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> absorber is being analyzed through simulation using SCAPS-1D software. The device's structure consists of the following layers, in the given order: ITO/ZnO/Zn(O,S):N/SnO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. The effect of fluctuating the thickness of Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, from 50 to 500 nm, and evaluated the higher PV parameter i.e Jsc of 30.15 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, Voc of 0.557 V, FF of 69.8 %, and PCE of 11.03 % with the 500 nm thickness yielding the highest performance and improved photovoltaic property. The research stresses the significance of adjusting the thickness for high-performing solar cells. The results present fresh viewpoints for device creation and underline the possibility of using Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> as a valuable material in producing cost-efficient and thin-film PV cells that are highly efficient.

articleTitle: Enhancing Khalifa Satellite Imagery Resolution with AI-Powered Super Resolution Generative Adversarial Networks (SRGAN)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: KhalifaSat is a multispectral remote sensing Earth observation satellite used for various analyses such as building detection and road extraction. However, the limited resolution of satellite images can result in blurry details. For this limitation to be removed, super resolution techniques have been introduced, with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) being a notable approach. This research proposes a novel algorithm called Hybrid SRGAN, which simplifies the Super-Resolution Generative Adversarial Network (SRGAN) model while maintaining high accuracy. The proposed modifications involve removing batch normalization layers and utilizing bicubic interpolation for resizing low-resolution images. By eliminating batch sampling, training speed and generalization across different image types are improved. To assess the performance of the suggested model by using the metrices like SSIM, PSNR, and BRISQUE, showcasing its superior reconstruction quality and overall performance, particularly in the luminance channel(YCbCr), when compared to cutting-edge algorithms.

articleTitle: Deep Learning and Grad-CAM for the Diagnosis of Pneumonia Based on X-Rays
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Millions of people throughout the world suffer from pneumonia, an extremely serious respiratory disease. An early and accurate diagnosis is crucial for the quick and effective treatment of pneumonia. Deep learning approaches have recently demonstrated promise in the recognition of medical imaging, particularly X-ray pictures. We propose deep learning-based method for recognising pneumonia from X-ray pictures in this paper. To categorise photos, we employ a convolutional neural network (CNN), and the Grad-CAM method visualises the model's predictions. The results of our investigation indicate that our proposed approach may successfully and reliably detect pneumonia in X-ray images and provide visual reasons for the predictions. By increasing the effectiveness and precision of pneumonia diagnosis, the application of this methodology has the potential to have a substantial impact on the medical industry.

articleTitle: A Survey Paper on Adenocarcinoma Detection Using Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Adenocarcinoma is a subdivision of carcinoma which grows in the glands that line inside our body organs. The paper reviews recently developed systems with deep learning methods using medical imaging modalities like Computer Tomography (CT) and Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) for the diagnosis of Adenocarcinoma. The study is done on the papers proposed in the past 5 years. The study compares with existing system on various performance measurements. Transfer learning technique with ResNet and Inception-v3 CNN models provide good results. Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) attracts the current scenario of Deep Learning. A good segmentation method with a powerful classifier can be used for medical image analysis.

articleTitle: Fuzzy-Sliding Mode Speed Controller with Active Damping Control for Dual PMSM Drives
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Mono inverter-powered dual motor drives are specially made to be smaller and less expensive than single motor drives and their performance is mainly influenced by the capability of the controller used. For high performance, the vector control technique is preferred over other approaches. Because of the dynamics non-linearity and time-varying properties, the control is a key challenge for dual Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM). This paper presents a fuzzy sliding mode speed controller for dual PMSM parallel operation. Here the master motor is controlled using a vector control strategy, whereas the slave motor is controlled using an open-loop strategy. But in different load torque, there is an oscillation in the slave motor speed brought on by the shift in rotor position. Therefore, oscillations are suppressed using active damping control, which also offers stable operation. The suggested controller comprises a dual PMSM speed control and damping control designed by combining the intelligence of fuzzy logic with the SMC for the steady functioning of both motors. The Fuzzy SMC performance is also compared to PI and Fuzzy logic controller. It has been observed that the Fuzzy SMC provides a better response for speed control of dual PMSM as compared to the PI and Fuzzy logic controller.

articleTitle: IoT Based Smart Plug
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: This study focuses on implementation of a system to make users aware of the usage of IoT based applications and promote sustainable living, energy saving, and behaviour change. In this context, the usage of smart plugs in the electrical system's distribution side is gaining popularity. Electrical gadgets called smart plugs can link a regular appliance to the internet. Additionally, it enables users to keep tabs on their energy use and so modify it. The study found that compared to ordinary houses, households with the proposed system installed used energy roughly less than 5 %. Participants' energy usage dropped when they were happier with obtaining automated systems and the associated knowledge. Results show that this programme can help people consume less energy, which is good for smart homes and smart communities. In recent decades, energy and energy management have emerged as significant research subjects. Making people aware of their energy usage habits can help to cut down on energy use dramatically. Using IoT-based techniques and smart plugs to collect data that is sent to the central database via the wireless-gateway, we apply a smart and sustainable technology in this project. When not in use, the Smart plugs can be turned on and off from the main server thanks to the system's design. This capability has led to the creation of a mechanism to turn off the smart plugs after business hours. In addition, we thoroughly examined the reason behind the lack of demand for the existing home automation systems in the market and found that most people are not ready to switch to a new system just to enjoy one or two features. Hence, the proposed system is integrated with multiple features which would attract more users and help to expand the practical implementation.

articleTitle: Covid-19 Detection Through Cough Sounds: A Comparative Study Using XGboost and RESNET
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Coronavirus disease (COVID-19) which is a rapidly spreading virus disease is considered as a huge crisis that the world is facing today, firstly happened in Wuhan city in China in the year 2019 December and within months spread to other countries. To date, total death in the world due to covid-19 exceeded 6 million and in India over 5 lakhs of lives have already vanished due to the virus attack. The losses are compounding every day. Diagnosis of the virus is most important because most of persons may be asymptomatic. Surprisingly, it has been listed by many studies that cough is the main reason for spreading the virus easily. In this paper, the virus detection is done using neural networks and a machine learning algorithm using recorded cough sounds. A virufy dataset containing recorded cough samples is taken for the research. Deep learning has been done using ResNet50 and XGBOOST is the classification algorithm.

articleTitle: Power Electronic Traction Transformer with Minimum Losses
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: The Power Electronic Traction transformer is an application of power electronics in the railway traction system. The development of the Power Electronic Traction transformer system is marked as an important milestone in the railway traction world. The conventional line frequency transformer system was the first established system in the railway traction system and it operates on the line frequency. In practical applications, the efficiency of the conventional line frequency system is abysmal due to the large size, heavy weight, harmonics, and switching losses, etc. So the power electronic traction transformer is developed which increases the overall efficiency of the traction system. The Power electronic traction transformer using a cyclo-converter was the first phase of the development of the Power electronic traction transformer system. It operates with a frequency in a few hundred-hertz range. The Power electronic traction transformer using a series load resonant converter was the second phase of development of the Power electronic traction transformer system, which is the recent development of the power electronic traction transformer system. This system uses a series load resonant converter which operates with a frequency in the kilohertz range, by which the size of the traction transformer can be reduced. ZVS and ZCS are applicable in the case of series loaded resonant converter by which the switching losses can be reduced. The scope of the thesis paper is limited to railway applications. This paper presents the design and simulation of a Power electronic traction transformer with a series load resonant converter.

articleTitle: Virtual Fencing To Prevent Human Wild Conflict
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: The conflict between humans and animals grows old as animals roam the land of civilization, eating crops carefully planted by humans. Wild animals such as elephants and wild boars will perish once they enter the fields, so people must make sure farming is safe. Once their food is exhausted in the forest, animals will gradually enter lands ordered by humans. So this has an impact on human-wildlife interventions. Keeping animals off the field is easy enough, but majority of the people will not consider safety, they immediately choose the easier option, even if it harms the animals. The virtual fence mentioned in this project does not make life. Various techniques are used to detect the presence of animals, including motion detection and image recognition. The process of entering and defining and using custom measures. It uses loud enough sound and high-intensity strobe light to warn everything around, threatening animals to advance.

articleTitle: A Novel Control Scheme for Harmonic Compensation in PV-Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Non-linear loads are frequently used in both domestic and industry-based applications. Currents with harmonic content are obtained when a non-linear load is coupled to the grid. These harmonics deteriorate the quality of the grid's voltage and current. A Proportional Integral-Modified Reduced Order Generalized Integrator based frequency lock loop (PI+MROGI-FLL) is developed for regulating the interconnecting inverter to mitigate the harmonics. The PI+MROGI-FLL is intended to analyze 3⊘reference currents by isolating the fundamental constituents from load currents. It offers many benefits, including improved harmonic mitigation, adaptable frequency and phase, synchronisation of the grid, and minimal computational burden. The suggested Controller is modelled in MATLAB/Simulink using a photo-voltaic system. The proposed controller's performance is compared with that of existing conventional controllers. In comparison to other controllers, the PI + MROGI controller exhibits higher harmonic mitigation capability.

articleTitle: Identification of Fake Reviews: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) approaches have witnessed rapid progress in the context of computers and smartphones, which has led to a number of exciting new applications. In many cases, these methods make it possible for the gadgets to carry out their functions in an intelligent manner. Utilizing common AI techniques such as machine learning, deep learning methods, natural language processing, knowledge representation as well as expert systems, may help the targeted apps become more intelligent and efficient. As the practice of shopping online becomes increasingly popular, an increasing number of people are considering making their essential purchases from companies that operate exclusively online. This method of shopping does not demand a significant amount of the customer's time. A customer enters an online store, conducts a search for the product that meets his or her needs, and then makes a purchase. Customers have difficulty acquiring items from Internet retailers owing to the low quality of the products offered in these stores. Customers will not make orders for a product unless they have first looked at its rating and read any reviews that have been posted about it. Reviews can be genuine or fake and can be either negative or positive. The opinions of other people are a source of happiness for the buyer who purchased the new items. In this case, a single negative fake review may influence the customer's decision whether to purchase the goods or not. At the same time, positive fake reviews give misleading information about the product and may lead to customers purchasing a low-quality product. In most cases, it is conceivable that this one review is a forgery. So, we have to remove this type of fake reviews and provide the users with the original reviews and ratings related to the products. Many methods are proposed by researchers around the globe. This paper reviews a few of such ideas proposed.

articleTitle: Speed Control of Variable Speed Wind Turbine Using Computational Intelligence Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Wind power generation systems, which can be run at constant speed or variable speed, are gaining a lot of attention as clean and secure renewable energy sources. Due to an increase in the production of wind energy, variable speed generation systems are more appealing than fixed speed systems. A variable speed wind turbine should run as close as practical to its ideal power coefficient to maximise the harvest of wind energy. In this study, a fractional order PID controller with parameters set using computational intelligence techniques is used to regulate the speed of a two-mass mass wind turbine system. Particle Swarm Optimization and Genetic Algorithm are both used for the purpose of comparison. MATLAB simulation shows that, the proposed fractional order PID controller exhibits improved response in terms of shorter settling times, reduced overshoot as compared to conventional PID controllers.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Machine Learning Algorithms for Heart Disease Prediction in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease is most significant of the leading causes of mortality in the modern society. An important concern in clinical data processing is the diagnosis of heart disease. The enormous amount of information collected by the healthcare field has been established as helpful for using machine learning (ML) to help with judgement and prediction. In this work, four supervised machine learning techniques such as K-nearest neighbour (KNN), Multi-layer perceptron Decision Tree (DT) and REPTree have been used for predicting heart disease. The developed classifier model is tested with “Heart disease Prediction” obtained from Kaggle Repository. The performance metrics used to evaluate the classifier models are accuracy, precision, recall and f1-score. The existing four machine learning classifiers has been evaluated to forecast cardiac diseases and obtained maximum accuracy of 99.7% for KNN classifier.

articleTitle: Holographic Lenses for the Precision Measurement of Surface Displacement in Speckle Metrology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: In laser speckle photography, monochromatic aberrations associated with imaging lenses limit the sensitivity and accuracy of in-plane displacement measurement. The presence of such aberrations results in the formation of deteriorated curved speckle correlation fringes. Good-quality conventional lenses with minimum monochromatic aberrations are costly and require time-consuming cumbersome processing in their fabrication. The limitation on the accuracy and sensitivity of measurement imposed by the aberrations of conventional lenses can be effectively tackled using suitably designed holographic lenses as properly designed holographic lenses give diffraction-limited imaging performance free from all monochromatic aberrations over an extended object field in speckle photography. Furthermore, holographic lenses are compact, lightweight, and low-cost optical elements. In the present investigation, imaging characteristics of holographic lenses to achieve diffraction-limited performance over an extended object field in speckle metrology have been studied. In-plane displacements given to an optical diffuser have been measured using a typical Duffy imaging system (that consists of a good quality conventional lens), a two-hololens imaging system, and a four hololens imaging system. A comparative analysis of the experimental results along with the theoretical results for the measurement of in-plane displacement using a good-quality conventional lens and a two and four elements holographic imaging system is presented. The results of the present investigation show that the low-cost holographic lenses can be advantageously used in speckle metrology for diffraction-limited imaging performance free of all monochromatic aberrations.

articleTitle: Detection of Optic Disc in Fundus Images Using K-Mean clustering with Outlier Removal Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy is a retinal disorder characterized by the pathological involvement of the blood vessels situated in the inner region of the retina. DR initially causes no symptoms or mild symptoms of vision problems, if left unnoticed, will lead to blindness. Ophthalmologists examine the fundus images showing the evolution of DR to look for any anomalies. Multiple strategies for supplementing the ophthalmologist with automated DR identification have been proposed in recent years. An important step towards early DR prediction is the optic disc (OD) segmentation, which can be challenging for any computer aided retinopathy prediction system. This study presents an improved clustering technique using k-means for finding outliers in clustered data. The algorithm is implemented on a benchmark dataset as well as a collection of real images obtained from hospitals. The efficacy of the algorithm was evaluated through experimental comparisons with alternative methods. The results presented show a considerable increase in the accuracy for segmenting the OD with less segmentation error.

articleTitle: A Survey on the Control Techniques used In Process Control
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Major works in the world is carried out in automation. Manual labor is being reduced due to certain factors like staff maintenance charges which includes wages and incentives, safety and precautionary measures, enormous requirement of products, fast action, human errors etc. In this automation era, various control techniques are developed which required manpower or supervision. This review paper consists of Part I Introduction representing the present scenario developed in modern era. Part II describes the Role of controllers in industries. Part III explains the different control techniques like conventional P/PI/PID controllers, Model Predictive Control, Fuzzy Logic, Neural Network, Reinforcement Learning, Deep learning control strategies. Part IV identifies the constraints faced in each technique and the development to other methods. Furthermore, future work section concludes by the upcoming advancements like RNN to forecast the action required in the area of process control. This review holds an insight to the researchers to enhance the level of development to meet the industry requirements.

articleTitle: MedApp: An Application For Patient's Personal Medical History Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Tracking one's medical records can be a challenge. To address this, a personal medical history maintenance app has been created to aid individuals in keeping track of their healthcare information. With this tool, users can store and update their medical history safely, including information about their past and current medical conditions, medications, allergies, and immunizations. They can also access their records and share them with healthcare providers as needed. Having all of this information in one place allows patients to play a more active role in their own healthcare and ensures that their medical history is always up-to-date and accurate. The app also includes a Quick Response (QR) code for accessing a patient's specific medical data, which can be shared with other healthcare providers to aid in decision-making. By being able to review a patient's previous medical records before treatment, better decisions can be made. This app serves as a bridge between patients and healthcare providers, offering a solution to the difficulties of tracking medical records.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Diabetic Retinopathy Using Pretrained Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: The retina is harmed by diabetic retinopathy (DR), a consequence of diabetes. Up to, 80% of people who have had diabetes for ten or more years are affected by this type of medical issue. Where the need for diabetic retinopathy identification is greatest, there is frequently a shortage of the necessary knowledge and tools. The majority of research in the area of diabetic retinopathy has relied on manual feature extraction or disease identification. So, the goal of this research is to make a deep learning neural network that can identify the disease in all of its forms. The suggested system enables a DR classification that accounts for normal eyes, mild DR, moderate DR, severe DR, and proliferative DR, which may aid ophthalmologists in making a preliminary decision. Our accuracy rates for estimating the degree of diabetic retinopathy from an image were 90% and 92% respectively, using the pre-trained Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) VGG-16 and MobileNet-V2.

articleTitle: Seven Class Skin Disease Classification using Pre-trained MobileNet Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: In areas with limited access to specialized medical care, CNN categorization of skin diseases can assist to increase the precision and efficacy of dermatological or skin cancer diagnosis. By automating the classification of ordinary instances, it can also lessen the workload of dermatologists so they can concentrate on more complicated situations. Skin disease classification using MobileNet is a study that aims to expand the accuracy and efficacy of skin ailment finding using a deep learning model. The suggested method makes use of the MobileNet architecture, a compact deep neural network model appropriate for devices with limited resources like smartphones. The dataset utilized in this study includes several different skin conditions, such as benign nevi, seborrheic keratosis, and melanoma. Using transfer learning, the model is trained on this dataset and achieves a high accuracy of over 95%. According to the study, the suggested method can be applied in real-world settings for the premature identification and detection of skin illnesses.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Classification and Grading of Breast Cancer: Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: The classification of the excised breast cancer cells and the attribution of a score based on how similar they are to healthy cells are both done in the laboratory. The final grade provides an indication of the prognosis and aids in selecting the best treatments. To categorize and grade cancer, machine learning algorithms have been developed, allowing hospitals to offer the best care. Breast cancer has been diagnosed and graded using a variety of learning methods, perhaps slowing its progression. This review covers earlier research on relevant methods that has been published by academics.

articleTitle: A Smart Electric Bicycle with Hybrid Charging Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: In this paper a free energy based electric bicycle with online and offline charging is proposed. The electric bicycle that works on the principle of regenerative braking with mounted foldable solar panels and an advanced EV charging station for charging the mounted Li-ion batteries are presented. An inclinometer is also used to measure the inclination of an object or surface. One effective way to improve the driving range of electric vehicles is through the use of regenerative braking. It involves using of motor to power the vehicle by consuming energy in motoring mode, and then converting kinetic energy into electrical energy during braking to charge the battery. Brushless DC (BLDC) motors are becoming a popular choice for electric vehicles due to their efficient and quiet operation, long lifespan, and superior speed versus torque characteristics at high speeds solar energy play an important role in the reduction of carbon emission. If we use traditional modes of transportation to travel between departments or firms, the amount of carbon footprint will increase rapidly, in order to avoid this, a bicycle with foldable solar panel is implemented The use of completely fuel-free and low-carbon bicycles instead of conventional transportation modes in businesses is made feasible due to the batteries being charged through regenerative braking. The simulations are done using MATLAB/ Simulink.

articleTitle: The Properties of Carbon Nano Tubes as Electrical Conductors A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Nanomaterials have gained a great deal of attraction due to their physical, chemical, electric and magnetic properties. The performance of all materials depends upon its properties. Here, the properties especially the electric conductivity of advanced carbon nanomaterials is specified and reported. Along with, the factors affecting and methods to improve the electrical conductivity of Carbon nano tube is mentioned. As the demand for advanced new conductors is increasing, a prior knowledge about the superior characteristics of these materials is necessary.

articleTitle: Detection of Non Helmet Riders and Extraction of Licence Plate Number
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: The current scenario of India's traffic laws poses a number of challenges, each of which may be addressed in a variety of ways. An increasing incidence of motorbike and moped-related fatalities have been linked to the common practice of driving without a headgear in India. The current system relies heavily on CCTV records to keep tabs on traffic offences, forcing cops to manually examine individual frames and, if the rider isn't wearing a helmet, focus in on their numberplate. However, this calls for a significant investment of time and resources, since traffic offences are common and the number of motorcyclists grows daily. What if there were a technology that could detect whether or not a motorcyclist was breaking the law by failing to wear a helmet and, if so, get the vehicle's registration number from the database? This study has been accomplished with recent success using HaaR, HoG, LBP, R-CNN, CNN features, etc. However, the pace, precision, and effectiveness of object identification and categorization are severely constrained by these works. In an effort to automate the process of finding instances of the traffic offense of not donning a headgear and retrieving the numberplate of vehicles, this study develops a Non-Helmet Driver identification method. The core idea is to use three tiers of DL for Image Classification. Individual, motor bike, headgear, and licence plate are all recognisedutilising YOLOv2's increasing levels of sophistication. Then, OCR is used to get the licence plate number. Particularly for the extraction of licence plate numbers, all of these methods are governed by a set of predetermined parameters and limits. Since moving images are used as input, the processing time is critical. By combining the aforementioned methods, we have developed a comprehensive system for identifying helmets and extracting licence plate numbers.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on the IoT - Based Electronic Healthcare Records Security, Privacy Issues, and Countermeasures Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is currently a widespread developing technology. Nowadays many fields are increasing their usage of IoT environments, for example, implementing it in agriculture, space, healthcare, manufacturing, construction, mining, smart homes, surveillance, and in almost every field. A great amount of data will be produced, transmitted, collected, stored, and processed in the cloud. Consequently, several threats and attacks will be increased. Security and Privacy issues have been the main cause of concern. To make it harder for attackers, IoT devices must be heavily secured. Privacy and security for everything to manage personalized data to make personalization. The IoT effectively communicates data using sensing data from remote locations to communicate to share private information. The main problem is that unauthorized users or attackers may affect the data at the time of Personal health care records, leading to the stealing of data. This paper presents a detailed survey of IoT Security, Privacy issues and countermeasures in the healthcare industry, and how to protect sensitive data. This review study intends to identify and evaluate research studies that have either been conceptualized or executed into action for EHRs management by utilizing blockchain technology. The survey looked at different research papers taken from a variety of different types of publications. The accessibility, privacy, and scalability of publications are the primary objectives of the in-depth analysis.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on Ensemble Machine Learning Approaches for Detection of Intrusion in IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Threats to network security have been increasing leading to severe network attacks such that a simple firewall will not be sufficient to deter challenging and complicated attacks. Therefore, the utilization of intrusion detection systems (IDS) with other security devices is imperative to safeguard networks. The intrusion detection systems monitor traffic, collect, and analyze information, and raise an alert when there is a breach of security. It also prevents unauthorized access, stops intrusions, records them, and alerts the network admin to guarantee enhanced security of the system. Attack detection employing a single machine learning (ML) algorithm is not effective. As a result, ensemble learning was employed to combine different algorithms. To be more specific, ensemble learning is a popular analytical method that trains different algorithms to address similar problems, then combines the results to make a strong prediction that outperforms a single algorithm. The paper aims to offer a complete review of the most important ensemble strategies utilized to improve the efficacy of detecting intrusion in Internet of Things networks. The findings demonstrate that the two ensemble learning techniques majority voting and weighted averaging may be implemented with the utmost simplicity while yet producing accurate results.

articleTitle: Domestic Violence Detection System Using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Domestic violence is a widespread problem that leaves victims feeling helpless and trapped. It refers to a pattern of abusive behavior in an intimate relationship, where one partner seeks to exert power and control over the other. To address this issue, we proposed a system that incorporates several advanced technological aspects to address domestic violence and support victims. It includes a speech recognition module that identifies abusive behavior patterns through specific words and phrases associated with domestic violence. Natural language processing techniques analyze the context and tone of the language to understand the emotional state of the victim and detect instances of emotional abuse. A camera system with computer vision capabilities detects physical violence and abuse signs through object detection and tracking in video footage. The system is accessible through a mobile app, enabling victims to collect evidence of abuse and access necessary resources and support services. Machine learning algorithms continuously improve the system's accuracy and performance by learning from a large dataset of abusive language patterns and visual cues. When abusive behavior is detected, the system can automatically send alerts to law enforcement and emergency contacts, providing immediate assistance. Recorded voice and video footage, along with associated analysis results, are securely stored as evidence for legal proceedings. By integrating these technological aspects, the system aims to empower victims, improve evidence collection, and support efforts to combat domestic violence.

articleTitle: Breaking classification Algorithms: A Black-Box Adversarial Attack for Data Poisoning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Poisoning attacks interfere with machine learning classifiers' performance by introducing malicious data into the learning dataset. In this paper, we propose a black-box adversarial attack for data poisoning in machine learning, where the attacker has no knowledge of the classifier's internal parameters or training data. Our attack utilizes a novel poison threat algorithm that leverages the gradient descent method to generate adversarial examples that deceive the classifier. We evaluate our attack on two popular classification algorithms, decision trees and support vector machines, using the random circles dataset. According to our results, the proposed attack has the ability to compromise the performance of both classifiers, highlighting the need for robust countermeasures against poisoning attacks.

articleTitle: A Study on Human Emotion Recognition Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Emotions are essential for humans and play an important role in cognition. Emotion is frequently linked to logical decision-making, outlook, interactional behavior, and, to a lesser extent, human intelligence. With a growing interest in ensuring “emotional” interactions amid machines and humans, there is a need for reliable solutions in recognizing human emotional states. Humans typically express their emotions through a variety of non-linguistic and indirect methods. Emotion detection is accomplished primarily through the use of six distinct strategies: facial emotion recognition, physiological signal recognition, speech variation, emotion recognition from audio and videos, and emotion recognition from EEG signals on datasets like RAVDESS, JAFFE, CK+, TESS, DEAP, etc. In general, these methods identify seven basic emotions. In addition, we compared different ways to recognize emotions in humans. Deep convolutional neural networks produced the best results for Facial Emotion Recognition, physiological signals, audio, video, and EEG, emotion recognition through speech with accuracies of 97.83 %, 85%, and 70%, 75%, 80% respectively.

articleTitle: DyslexiScan: A Dyslexia Detection Method from Handwriting Using CNN LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Dyslexia is a common neurobiological learning disorder that affects millions of individuals worldwide. It is characterized by difficulty in reading and can have a significant impact on an individual's academic and professional development. Individuals with Dyslexia have trouble interpreting words and visual stimuli. While it is not a condition that can be cured, it can be effectively managed through specialized education and training. People with Dyslexia are capable of learning and being creative, but may require different teaching methods. Early recognition of dyslexia is crucial in order to provide children with the appropriate learning strategies and support they need to succeed. One potential method for detecting Dyslexia is through the analysis of handwriting patterns. DyslexiScan is a novel approach for Dyslexia Detection from Handwriting using a combination of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models. The CNN component is used to extract features from handwriting images, while the LSTM component is used to analyze the sequential structure of handwriting. DyslexiScan is trained on a dataset of handwriting samples from both dyslexic and non-dyslexic individuals and is evaluated using standard metrics. The results indicate that the model is capable of accurately identifying dyslexia in individuals with high accuracy, suggesting that it could be a useful tool for the early detection and intervention of Dyslexia. Additionally, this approach could be used in a clinical setting or in the education field, to help professionals to identify Dyslexia in a more efficient and accurate way.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Anti-Sleep Goggles for Drowsiness Detection while Driving to Avoid Accidents
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Driving while fatigued is extremely dangerous. Since that there is a danger to drivers' lives, it is crucial to resolve this issue. If the driver feels sleepy while driving, it would be very difficult to avoid accidents. The goal of this project is to create a gadget that will aid drivers in protecting themselves against accidents caused by lethargy or sleepiness, especially at night. It is proposed to create an electronic gadget that can recognise when a driver is tired and it activates an alert system. It will produce sound as an alarm and if the driver doesn't wakes up for the alarm, then the device sends a serial data via Bluetooth and there by the receiver side which is connected to the electronic control unit (ECU) of the vehicle which slowly applies the brake and turns off the engine. Here, the programmed device configured to detect drowsiness, Serial transmission and alarm were developed and set into a Goggles using Arduino Nano. On the other hand, an eye blink sensor was employed, to determine whether a person is sleepy or not. It is also demonstrated that the tiredness level of a driver's level of tiredness can be assessed by using an Infra-Red sensor as an eye blink sensor. The prototype of the system has been developed and tested to be accurate.

articleTitle: Real-Time Student Emotion and Drowsiness Detection Using YOLOv5 and CNN for Enhanced Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Recognition of student's behaviour in class based on video has a significant impact on both teacher quality and student attention. Previously, student behaviour recognition focused only on single students with low performance and efficiency. This study proposes a system for detecting student behaviour and attention in the classroom using computer vision and machine learning techniques and it uses a webcam to capture video of the students and analyse their facial expressions and eye movements to determine whether they are paying attention or not. This can also detect the emotions of students. The final output of our proposed system is, it can detect different kinds of student behaviours in classrooms, such as attention in class, drowsiness, emotion of students and finally provide the rating for staff.

articleTitle: VN-IDS: An Integrated Virtual Node Protection in Cloud Environment using Intrusion Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Cloud computing is vital area for information storage, application deployment, and resources sharing through public cloud or private cloud. Cloud virtual resources such as Virtual Nodes (VN), software applications, virtual memory, physical storage, virtual server can enter into down state due to malicious flood. In this works malicious virtual node detection are implemented for synthetic dataset using machine learning techniques. Proposed systems algorithm has been evaluated using NSL KDD dataset. In this work VN on cloud environment are protected against malicious floods using unsupervised and supervised techniques. Proposed system has the accuracy of 93.7% for synthetic dataset and 94% for NSL KDD Dataset. Proposed system have less time for implementing mitigation service against malicious attacks, compare to SVM and C4.5 and it also reduces the services unavailable time.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Architecture Based Skin Cancer Detection Using Deep Belief Network and Grey Wolf Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Skin cancer is becoming more common every year, and this trend is seen in various nations. As a result of lifestyle modifications and sun-seeking behavior, skin cancer cases are increasing. Melanoma can be successfully treated when skin cancer is discovered early; as a result, curing and surviving melanoma directly depend on eliminating it when it is in its early stages. Unfortunately, traditional procedures for detecting skin cancer can be imprecise and frequently result in more testing. In this work, artificial intelligence (AI) techniques are used to create a special deep learning model that combines deep belief networks and grey wolf optimization. By integrating the advantages of two reliable methods, this network achieves maximum accuracy. The suggested method's performance is evaluated against current state-of-the-art methods and a DBN. The effectiveness of the proposed technique is evaluated using the Human Against Machine (HAM10000) dataset. The proposed technology's accuracy and effectiveness allow for the early clinical detection of skin cancer by doctors and dermatologists.

articleTitle: Gui that Detects Liver Disease Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: The liver is an important organ because it produces vitamins & substances necessary for the survival of the decaying body, including iron, toxins, proteins, & carbs. It aids in vitamin and mineral metabolism, tubular muscle growth, and blood coagulation. Factors including alcohol intake, opioid painkiller usage, poor nutrition, and underlying medical disorders have all been linked to the development of liver disease. The results of a patient's blood tests and physical exam may help physicians determine risk factors for liver disease. Data mining methods may help speed up the process of identifying liver illness. When more information is utilized, the vaccination becomes more precise. This design aims to address this issue by incorporating a method of device mastery into the process of evaluating liver disease. The primary motive of this system is to apply a wide angles set of concepts to perceive healthy folks that are honestly affected by liver disease. The design of this system also aims to evaluate and contrast different bracketing algorithms according to their operational characteristics. A Python-based graphical interface for Stoner is now being development to aid clinicians in the assessment of liver issues. The user interface may be used by soothsayers and medical interpreters as a web application for liver trials.

articleTitle: A Study on Computer Aided Neurological Disorder Detection and Classification from fMRI Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Machine Learning (ML) systems, particularly analytical modelling and medical imaging have emerged over the years as one of the key techniques aiding researchers in developing algorithms for resolving challenging diagnostic issues. Deep Learning (DL) is a sophisticated approach that consider higher level of features for categorization. In neuro-developmental and mental disorders, Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is categorized as complex issue. Since ADHD cannot be directly diagnosed using a common medical test at the early stages of the disease, researchers have characterized it as a multilayered problem over time. In addition to their physical manifestations, the majority of ADHD patients, according to clinical data, experience academic difficulties. As a result, it is believed that functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) is the best technique for identifying functional activities in various region of brain. Similarly, fMRI can be utilized to comprehend Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, and other brain related abnormalities. By utilizing DL methods, it is possible to improve the accuracy of identifying neurological disorders with fMRI dataset. This study analyzes the available research on DL and ML models for diagnosing neurological diseases. It is anticipated that, the evaluation serves as a catalyst for additional research on different methods for neuro disease diagnosis and monitoring.

articleTitle: A Flexible Dashboard Architecture for Monitoring the Performance of Field Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Inaccurate measurement of physical quantities due to the failure of measurement devices itself is a critical problem to be addressed by the process industries. The existing user interface that these process industries employ for functionality evaluation of devices is given a fixed appearance from the very beginning of their purchases and installation. It is impossible for the device manufacturer to provide customized assistance to their clients without the investment of huge amount of time and money in research and development activities on each service request of monitoring new features. Efficient and reliable industrial operations can be ensured by developing a cloud-based, flexible dashboard infrastructure for modeling and analyzing the parameters indicating the performance of devices, which can subsequently be tailored customer specific later on. This also offers an economically viable solution for the manufacturing firm as it does not call for trained domain specialists and rigorous coding practices frequently.

articleTitle: Precise Localization of Optic Disc Region for Accurate Glaucoma Diagnosis Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Glaucoma is a leading cause of blindness worldwide, and early detection is crucial for effective management. In this research will propose a novel methodology for the detection of glaucoma in retinal fundus images using deep reinforcement learning and other modern AI-based algorithms. The proposed method includes This program is built using deep reinforcement learning for active object localization, as well as machine learning techniques. For input picture validation and active object localization for Region of Interest (ROI) detection and feature extracts using CNN, a deep reinforcement learning model with a deep Q network is used on the basis of MDP. The model is tailored to a specific class and allows an agent to focus on areas with the potential to identify the exact location of pressure variation in fundus images happening in the Optic Disc (OD) region called the glaucomatous Region. The agent is instructed to fine-tune a bounding box by means of straightforward transformational actions in order to precisely determine the location of the Optic Disc. The localization agent being discussed is developed using deep reinforcement learning techniques and its performance is measured using the Kaggle fundus images dataset.

articleTitle: A Review on the Breast Histopathological Images, Processing and Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Cancer in the breast is a very fatal cancer among the women. A confirmation of its presence can be made mainly by the biopsy. The histopathological image analysis exhibits an indispensable role in the spotting, care and survival among the patients. For the sufficient accuracy and predictability breast histopathological image analysis and artificial intelligence has to work hand by hand. In this retrospection, we have gathered an overview on the breast histopathology images, its processing, analysis and classification based on different algorithms and learning techniques.

articleTitle: Non-Contact methods for assessment of respiratory parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: Respiratory parameters are very important signs that the human body shows about its well-being. These parameters have been a field of interest for different areas, ranging from healthcare to sports. The recent global pandemic situation has made the researchers to focus more on non-invasive or contactless monitoring of the respiratory parameters. This review paper tries to find out the technologies developed on the field of contactless respiratory monitoring systems. There were many reviews done on contact-based techniques for monitoring of respiratory parameters. But the reviews on contactless techniques are a few. Majority of the contactless techniques falls into four classifications: audio-based, camera-based, radio-based andlaser-based. Each classification is found effective in monitoring a certain set of parameters. The performance and suitability of these techniques are studied on different situations to find the better techniques for a set of conditions.

articleTitle: Two-Layered Machine Learning Approach for Sentiment Analysis of tweets related to Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: This study aims to perform Sentiment Analysis (SA) on social media data related to Electric Vehicles (EVs) using two layered unsupervised and supervised machine learning methods. A large dataset of tweets mentioning EVs is collected and preprocessed by removing stop words, emojis, and URLs. Unsupervised machine learning algorithms are applied to the processed data to identify sentiment patterns in the tweets. The results obtained from this method identifies distinct sentiment based on the words used in the tweets and label the same. The labeled data is further used to develop a model using various supervised learning algorithms for SA. The experimental results show that the Random Forest classifier has outperformed the other algorithms in terms of improved accuracy, precision, recall, and F-1 score. This work provides insights into the sentiment of EV users and non-users and thus can be used by policymakers and manufacturers to improve the adoption of EVs.

articleTitle: Design and Deployment of ML Model for Cardiac Disease Prediction-A review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: One of the most life-threatening diseases is cardiovascular disease. Its high fatality-rate catalysis nearly 17 million deaths worldwide. Prompt diagnosis assists in treating the disease at the right time to intercept mortality. Analyzing the existence and absence of the disease can be done using a variety of machine learning and deep learning techniques. In this review paper the complete procedure to make intelligent model is discussed. The UCI dataset is used in this project to classify cardiac disease using logistic regression techniques. To enhance the execution of the model, pre-processing of data by uncluttering the dataset, detecting the missing values is done and feature selection was accomplished by correlation with the target value for all the features. The distinctly positive correlated features were chosen. Then classification is performed by splitting the dataset into training data and testing data in the ratio of 80:20 split-up. The designed model secured 83.6% accuracy. The effectiveness of the proposed model was thoroughly gratifying and was competent to predict evidence of having heart disease in a certain individual which exhibited quality precision (77%) and recall (89%). This heart disease prediction system amplifies medical care and mitigates the cost. This research paper gives us significant knowledge that can help us predict, if the patient has a defective heart or not. The proposed work's evaluation has been carried out in Google Colab. Deployment has been done using the joblib library.

articleTitle: Translational Bioinformatics Ontology In Healthcare With Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovations in Engineering and Technology (ICIET)
abstract: The topic of health informatics known as “translational bioinformatics,” or TBI, is one that is expanding. It gives clinical significance to biological research. The confluence of molecular bioinformatics, biostatistics, statistical genetics, and clinical informatics. We give an overview of bioinformatics, focusing first on preclinical research applications where significant advancements have been made over the past 20 years or so. Next, we look at clinical uses that have generated a lot of interest because of their potential, like clinical genotyping, early detection, predictive disease models, customized treatment, and wellness monitoring. The issues chosen essentially reflect our confidence that this potential will start to be fulfilled soon. The goal of this study is to represent the advancement in biological data and clinical practice. Its benefits are expanded in both biological and healthcare industries. Its emphasis on applying biomedical research in actionable knowledge on humans to improve their health through the use of modern technologies.
